game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk, a cracked obelisk: the rune scholar must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Shelf Sorter: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of spirit candles from smallest to largest.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk: a cracked obelisk
core_gameplay_loop: In Cracked Obelisk, repeat each round: Use sort() to rearrange shelves of spirit candles from smallest to largest. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the order_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the sealed archway using at most 21 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The sealed archway reached with actions_used <= 21.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 21 before the sealed archway is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Shelf Sorter
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Shelf Sorter' (Week 7 slot 6), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Cracked Obelisk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how order_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The sealed archway reached with actions_used <= 21.
